purpose: Affected native DOCX-reading workflow with a stable local-file discovery control under the current repaired hybrid source; no new API, gate, full-189 run or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: Preserved Order 104 never read its source tests reliably: Aug31 guessed an answer file without reading source questions; Sep6 repeatedly routed DOCX files to a UTF-8 editor reader. Current source already includes a native read-only Writer document.read_file, improved local-file recall and corrected Holo feedback. Verify those existing reusable repairs on this previously un-retested affected workflow, without adding a task-aware answer API or another gate.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: The model discovers observed local files and reads the actual test questions and provided example through the correct public document reader before composing its own answer text. Original evaluator reward 1 is the affected objective; successful source reading alone is partial behavior evidence. Control 110 retains its prior exact-path discovery and clipboard pass.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One attempt and one fresh guest per task with two workers. Stop at terminal results, 100 global steps, 50 local steps per plan, one soft restart, 1800 Agent seconds, existing environment/transport/source limits or 30-GiB disk stop. Keep source unchanged until workers and supervisor exit. Preserve every result and do not repeat an unchanged condition.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Keep Aug31 and Sep6 failures immutable. Order 110 passed the Sep4 cohort and Sep6 integrated run; it controls shared discovery, forwarding, and guest setup, not grammar reasoning. Do not present this integrated-current-source replay as a one-factor ablation or add its outcomes to an older full denominator.
repair_hypothesis.focused_verification: The native Writer reader previously passed a synthetic fresh-guest read-only validation and 338 related checks. Current source just passed 221 Holo/Writer tests plus Ruff/diff checks. Offline catalog inspection retrieves document.read_file for Word/DOCX reading and includes it with filesystem.find for an explicit DOCX location query. No new source or test changes are introduced for this replay.
repair_hypothesis.decoding: Retain qwen3.5-4b and holo3.1-4b at the current split endpoints, binary thinking, 4096/1024 output caps, unchanged temperatures, complete-call stop and all current runtime budgets.

selection.method: Affected Order 104 preserved DOCX discovery/reader failures plus consecutively passing Order 110 exact local-file discovery/clipboard control; one attempt each in source order.
